description: Shared behavior requirements. Provider bindings supply values and applicability; these definitions contain no vendor event names, paths or response formats.

invariants.name: Registration remains discoverable
invariants.behavior: The host still reads the registration location written by the connector in its declared scope.
invariants.failure: The hook is never invoked, so connector-side fail-closed behavior cannot protect the action.

invariants.name: Registration shape remains accepted
invariants.behavior: The host accepts the connector's configuration keys and handler type.
invariants.failure: An installed registration is rejected or ignored.

invariants.name: Required events remain available
invariants.behavior: The host still delivers the events used for inspection or lifecycle handling.
invariants.failure: An existing inspection or lifecycle boundary disappears.

invariants.name: Incoming data remains decodable
invariants.behavior: Declared payload fields have types the local decoder accepts.
invariants.failure: A payload cannot be decoded or a consumed field is no longer available.

invariants.name: Blocking responses remain effective
invariants.behavior: The host still honors the connector's actual deny response on its enforcement event.
invariants.failure: A connector deny no longer prevents the protected action.

invariants.name: Inspection completes before execution
invariants.behavior: An enforcement hook remains a pre-action barrier with a compatible explicit time budget.
invariants.failure: The host executes before the verdict or cancels the configured inspection budget.

invariants.name: Failure behavior remains enforceable
invariants.behavior: The host still honors the connector's declared blocking exit status where the connector relies on it.
invariants.failure: The connector's failure response is treated as permission to continue.

invariants.name: Lifecycle identities remain usable
invariants.behavior: Fields used to pair actions and outcomes remain available with compatible types.
invariants.failure: Action/outcome pairing loses its identity or cannot decode it.
